title: Akiyama Mizuki — You Gotta Come With Me!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Uh oh...
I overdid this part again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I wanted to try using this effect in our next video. Maybe I should cut it out of this one...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Amia, are you free right now? I have a quick question.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Yuki.
And she has a question for me? That's pretty rare.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <The intro for the sample you sent over had me a little confused. Were you going for...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's been a week since Mafuyu started staying over at Kanade's place...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She had trouble talking about anything initially, but she's talking like normal again and seems to be doing a lot better.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Huh...? Is it just me or does your voice sound a little different?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I don't think it's noise of anything, but your voice sounds like it's echoing...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<There's nothing wrong on my end.
But I'll try restarting since it could be a computer issue.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Again, there's that echo... I dunno what's going on... Nothing like this has ever happened before...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What just happened?! That was really loud!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Sorry...
A pile of things just fell over...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <K's room is filled with piles of books and boxes.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I see...
K, it might be a good idea to clean your room.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, Yuki, I think I know what I was hearing now...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I think K left her mic on.
Your voice might've been coming through yours and hers.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, you're right. I forgot to mute myself. I'll do that now...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Things really are more fun when all four of us are together.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We all have our worries, but being here doesn't make them seem as big of a problem.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And I'm sure Mafuyu feels the same way...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Me too. This seems like a good place to stop for me, and I'm getting sleepy.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, can I ask you all something before you leave?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're asking this now? We're still working on this song.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, I know it doesn't make sense to throw an after-party right now, but I really wanna see your faces!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We can celebrate N25 finally returning to business as usual. How does that sound?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Business as usual? But sure, I'm willing to go...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Nice! That's step one! Step two is a question of where!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I can't wait to see all of you!>
